device_health_intro: What you do here is bigger than just a workout — you are building a stronger body, saving the planet, and earning real rewards all at once.
device_point_health_body: Every minute on the bike strengthens your heart, burns energy, and builds a more vibrant, active body.
device_point_planet_body: Your human effort turns into real, clean electricity. Every pedal reduces carbon emissions and contributes to a greener future.

about_subtitle: Intellaqa-HPC Bike — transform your physical effort into real green electricity and endless rewards
about_step1_body: Sit on any available Intellaqa-HPC bike at any listed location — no booking required.
about_step2_body: Log in via the Intellaqa app or scan the QR code directly from the screen to activate the device.
about_step3_body: Every pedal revolution generates real electricity fed into the green grid — track your watts live.
about_step4_body: Your points accumulate automatically on the leaderboard — reach the top and claim exclusive rewards.
about_ben1_body: Every move you make is a spark for your day's vitality — it gets your blood flowing, clears your mind, and gives you the sustained energy for a healthier, more vibrant body.
about_ben2_body: Your effort converts into clean electricity that reduces your carbon footprint and contributes to a sustainable green future.
about_ben3_body: Points stack with every watt you produce — top the leaderboard and qualify for prizes and exclusive rewards.
